faq.heading: Questions parents actually ask
faq.intro: Short answers. If yours is not here, the contact page is the other place to leave it.
faq.seoTitle: Santa Letter FAQ | Ordering, Dates, and Delivery
faq.seoDescription: Answers about Santa letters and emails: what to tell us, how a printed letter is mailed, when to order, and what happens before checkout opens.

items.q: What do I need to tell you?
items.a: The form on the product page. The child's name, age, and town, something they did well, and anything you want Santa to mention: a friend, a pet, a wish list, or something they are working on.

items.q: How is the printed letter mailed?
items.a: Standard letters are printed in full color and mailed First-Class by USPS from the US mainland, in a North Pole-themed envelope. Order mailed letters by Wednesday, December 9, 2026, 5:00 PM CT, for delivery before Christmas.

You pick the date, any day through December 24, 2026. The email is sent to a parent or guardian email, never to a child, on the date you pick. We do not publish Santa's sending address on this site. If you pick today and the letter is still in review, it waits until it is approved.

Order mailed letters by Wednesday, December 9, 2026, 5:00 PM CT, for delivery before Christmas. They are printed in full color and mailed First-Class by USPS from the US mainland. Email letters can be ordered any day through December 24, 2026, and are delivered on the date you pick.

items.q: Can I order for more than one child?
items.a: Yes. Order a separate letter for each child, or use the sibling bundle. The bundle is one flat price of $28.95 for 2 to 5 children in the same household. Each child gets their own letter in its own envelope, all mailed to the same address, First-Class by USPS. Families with more than 5 children can add a separate letter.
The button says coming soon until a payment link is on that letter. You can still fill in the form and keep it in the cart on this device. Leave your email and we will be in touch.

items.q: Do you ship outside the United States?
items.a: This store mails printed letters in the United States only. An address outside the country is not an option on this site.

items.q: What if a detail is wrong?
items.a: Use the contact page as soon as you notice. If we made the mistake, we correct it. If the letter has already been mailed, it cannot be pulled out of the post.

shipping.heading: How the letter gets there
shipping.intro: Two different trips. The printed letter goes through the mail. The email goes out on a date you choose.
shipping.seoTitle: Santa Letter Shipping | Mail and Email
shipping.seoDescription: Standard printed Santa letters are mailed in the United States by USPS First-Class Mail. Emails go out on the date you choose.

sections.heading: Printed letters
sections.body: Standard printed letters are printed in full color on the US mainland and mailed First-Class by USPS. Order mailed letters by Wednesday, December 9, 2026, 5:00 PM CT, for delivery before Christmas. December is a busy month for the mail, so that date is the one to trust.

sections.heading: Emails
sections.body: You pick the delivery date on the form. Email letters can be ordered any day through December 24, 2026, and are delivered on the date you pick. The address has to belong to a parent or guardian, never a child. If you pick today and the letter is still in review, it waits until it is approved. Check the spam folder if the day arrives and the inbox looks empty, then write to us.

sections.heading: Where we ship
sections.body: The United States. An address outside the country is not an option on this site.

sections.heading: What the price covers
sections.body: The printed letter is $15.95 and the email is $6.95. The sibling bundle is one flat price of $28.95 for 2 to 5 children in the same household. Families with more than 5 children can add a separate letter. A separate shipping fee is not listed on this site.

sections.heading: What you do

contact.heading: A question before you order
contact.intro: The form on the letter you want is what we use to write it. Use this page for anything else.
contact.seoTitle: Contact | Custom Letters from Santa Claus
contact.seoDescription: Contact Custom Letters from Santa Claus about a letter or an email. Leave a note and we will be in touch.

sections.heading: What to use the form for
sections.body: A question about timing, 2 or more children at one address, or a detail you are not sure how to phrase. The order itself belongs on the product page, so the answers stay attached to that letter.

privacy.heading: What we hold onto
privacy.intro: How this site handles the details you type, the cart in your browser, and a simple page view.
privacy.seoTitle: Privacy Policy | Custom Letters from Santa
privacy.seoDescription: How Custom Letters from Santa Claus handles the details you type, the cart saved in your browser, and the page view sent to our own server.

sections.heading: The details you type
sections.body: Names, ages, towns, stories, wish lists, dates, and mailing addresses are used only to write and send the letter or email you ordered. A parent or guardian places the order, and a parent or guardian email is required. We do not ask a child to use the site, and we do not collect a child's email. The email product is delivered only to a parent or guardian email.

sections.heading: This browser
sections.body: The cart, and a notify-me note if you leave one, stay in local storage on this device. Clearing the browser clears them. They are not sent anywhere by that form.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Card numbers are not typed into this site. When a product has a payment link, that button sends you to the payment provider, and the price on that link is the price that is charged. The details you entered are not added to that payment link. Until a link is set, the button says coming soon and no order is placed.

sections.heading: Page views
sections.body: Opening a page sends a note to our own server with the path and the referrer. It is not an advertising network. We do not use a child's details for ads. We do not sell a list.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep the personalization and the letter only long enough to fulfill the order and cover the refund window. After that, we delete those details or strip them so they no longer identify the child.

sections.heading: Email
sections.body: Leave your email on the contact page or with a coming-soon note. That address should be a parent or guardian. We will be in touch. The cart itself stays on this device.

terms.heading: Terms of sale
terms.intro: Plain terms for ordering a personalized letter or email from Santa.
terms.seoTitle: Terms of Sale | Custom Letters from Santa
terms.seoDescription: Terms for ordering a personalized Santa letter or email, including the details you supply and how payment works.

sections.heading: The offer
sections.body: The printed letter is $15.95. The email is $6.95. The sibling bundle is one flat price of $28.95 for 2 to 5 children in the same household. Families with more than 5 children can add a separate letter. Each page lists what that order includes.

sections.heading: Your details
sections.body: You are the adult placing the order. You are responsible for the spelling of the child's name and for the mailing address or parent email you type. The letter is written from those answers. The email product is sent only to a parent or guardian email, never to a child.

sections.heading: Mailing and the date
sections.body: A standard printed letter is printed in full color and mailed First-Class by USPS from the US mainland. We do not promise a delivery day for the post. Order mailed letters by Wednesday, December 9, 2026, 5:00 PM CT, for delivery before Christmas. An email can be ordered any day through December 24, 2026, and is sent on the date you choose after the letter is approved.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Card numbers are not typed into this site. When a product has a payment link, that link is where payment happens, and the price on the link is the price that is charged. The details you typed are not added to that payment link. Until a link is set, the button says coming soon and no order is placed.

sections.heading: The shop
sections.body: Custom Letters from Santa Claus, Grayson, Louisiana.

refunds.heading: If something is wrong
refunds.intro: Personalized letters cannot be un-mailed. This is how we handle a problem before that, and a mistake that is ours.
refunds.seoTitle: Refunds | Custom Letters from Santa Claus
refunds.seoDescription: Refunds for Santa letters and emails. A mailed letter cannot be pulled back. Tell us before it goes out if you need to cancel.

sections.heading: Before it goes out
sections.body: If you reach us before a printed letter is mailed, or before an email is sent, we cancel the order and return the payment.

sections.heading: If we get it wrong
sections.body: A name we mistyped, or an email that did not go on the date you chose, is ours to fix. Tell us as soon as you notice.

sections.heading: After it is mailed
sections.body: A letter that has entered the post cannot be recalled. If the mistake was in the details you sent, that is not a refund. If the mistake was ours, we send a replacement.
